title: Too delicate for usage.
text: Too delicate for usage.. It feels very delicate.  In the end I decided i would use the cup and the strainer as a ‘teapot’, I removed the green plastic as I wasn’t sure about the ‘plastic + hot water’.  Once this was my set up, I was happy.  In fact the tea strainer was all I need, which defeats why I need the rest of it!
